note: M6 pins exactly one Take vocabulary source (plan Task 4). The vendored source is the unmodified pinned donor file; the Node parity harness verifies source_sha256 before executing it and runs the shared fixture corpus through both the pinned TS source and the Python v2 vocabulary. import_resolution_dependency.note: enums.ts has no imports at all (self-contained module-level `as const` arrays); needs no @/ path resolution and no other vendored file.

take_shot_vocabulary.excluded_reason: Lifecycle (SHOT_STATUSES), rendered-asset (ASPECT_RATIOS) and provenance (ANALYSIS_SOURCES) vocabularies are out of scope for M6's ShotSpecV2 (plan Fixed Implementation Contract: "lifecycle/provider/rendered-asset enums are excluded").
take_shot_vocabulary.parity_coverage_notes: Pure string-literal const arrays, no regex/locale/Unicode parity concerns unlike the M5C ports. Parity is exact set-and-order equality between each TS array and its Python StrEnum's member order, plus per-case validity checks for known-invalid and compound-string candidates. No residual divergence.

import_resolution_dependency.note: novel-outline-drama-fields.ts imports SHUANG_TYPE_SET from novel-commercial-appeal-isomorph.ts (self-contained), detectStakesMismatchText from novel-commercial-appeal-audit.ts (which re-exports it from novel-stakes-common-sense.ts, self-contained; audit.ts's only other runtime import is novel-commercial-appeal-isomorph.ts, already vendored, plus a type-only import of novel-chapter-craft-check.ts that is erased at compile time and needs no vendoring), and OUTLINE_DRAMA_PRIORITY_LINE_SSOT from novel-emotion-core-contract.ts (self-contained). huohuo_drama_fields.excluded_reason: M6 v1's ShuangwenAnalysis contract (plan Fixed Implementation Contract) carries only chapter_start/chapter_end, hen/shuang/ji/pan evidence, an optional shuang_type, and findings — no book-level fields, no non-Shuangwen chapter narrative fields, and no prompt-block or completion/repair orchestration surface has any R2 consumer (spec section 5.3: "Completion/repair orchestration, LLM calls, donor persistence, and donor authority are excluded").
intentional_deviations: The Python port re-derives the same missing/invalid signal assertOutlineChapterFields computes for the five Shuangwen-relevant labels, rather than reimplementing the donor's own 13-field non-Shuangwen chapter contract, which R2 does not need. Parity fixtures therefore supply complete boilerplate values for every non-Shuangwen required label so assertOutlineChapterFields's real, unmodified, fully-composed output is directly comparable on the Shuangwen-relevant subset.
huohuo_drama_fields.parity_coverage_notes: Branch-complete corpus covers all six pinned shuang_type values, a missing beat, a too-short beat, an unrecognized type, an ambiguous/compound type (first-token-invalid and first-token-valid), chapter 9+ non-applicability (with and without beats present), a stakes mismatch, an explicit-anchor stakes pass, a no-signal stakes skip, translated (English) beat text, non-keyword filler beat text, cross-episode chapter slicing from one shared outline, and empty semantic content.
